about_the_game:
Goblin Dice & Cleave is a turn-based tactical dicebuilder RPG, with a roguelite approach to progression offering co-operative and competitive combat for up to 4 players. Play as a crew member of the Black Maw gang and set out to purify your next corrupted biome.

Solo or in co-op, traverse interconnected wastelands. Capture creatures, make pacts with the shadows and confront your opponents in intense duels. Every choice, failure or victory leaves a lasting mark in these hybrid biomes, where procedural generation and reactive storytelling intertwine. Continue the legacy of the legendary Graskar the One-Eyed in his fight against Corruption.

If you find Goblin Dice & Cleave intriguing, add it to your Steam wishlist.

If not, add it anyway. The dice might just surprise you.

The game is based on a unique tactical combat system: dynamic turn-by-turn combat, punctuated by the Timewar, a strategic timeline where every action must be planned, triggered, delayed or cancelled manually at the key moment.

Attack, parry, counter, dodge, provoke...

It's all about timing, instinct and, above all, reading your opponent's behavior.

Anticipate his moves, foil his bluffs, bet on his intentions...

And turn your intuition into a tactical advantage.

GAME MODES

Versus mode

Take on your friends in teams or solo, up to 4 players. Bluff, betrayal and chaos around the table.

Campaign mode

Solo or in pairs, explore corrupted biomes, capture creatures and purify lands in evolving runs, blending procedural generation and reactive storytelling.

Every choice you make can have a lasting impact on the behavior of your characters... and the world around you.

GAMEPLAY 

Build your dice, summon your troops and engage in combat in a real-time tactical system.

Bluff, anticipate, read behavior... you'll need to pull out all the stops to survive and take the spoils.

Capture the creatures of your choice with tailor-made traps. String together combos to unleash your full power.

Control your destiny with a strategic dicebuilding system, where every roll can turn in your favor... if you've made a pact with the right forces. If not... hope you still have enough fingers.

BIOME EXPLORATION

Biomes are corrupted dungeons, procedurally generated and evolving according to your choices and actions in real time.

A pact signed. An ally betrayed. A creature captured. Every decision alters your rate of corruption.

The biome reacts to your behavior: some paths close, others open. Enemies change strategy. Events are triggered or chained differently.

The world is watching you, adapting... and turning every run into a unique, unpredictable, sometimes fatal experience.

CHARACTERS & SKILLS

Each class has:

  • a unique pet.

  • strategic liabilities.

  • a powerful active talent.

  • and an evolving skill tree.

Don't just roll dice.

Alter your summons, weave synergies with your creatures and their environment, then unleash devastating combos.

Each class offers a distinct style of play and an evolving skill tree.

Thanks to your talents or passives, you can transmute your summons to suit the situation.

Transform an ordinary goblin into a fire goblin, capable of traversing a molten biome or countering an enemy with incandescent attacks.

Terrain, biomes, corruption and reputation influence your tactical choices every turn.

SYNERGIES & COMBOS

Combine your passives and talents, pets and summons to generate tactical effects in perfect alchemy with your build.

Manipulate the environment, thwart the effects of enemy passives or talents and turn the situation to your advantage.

Each summoned creature also has its own passives and active talents, making each game unpredictable and each summons unique.

In Goblin Dice & Cleave, it's not your deck that makes you strong...

It's your bond with your creatures and your ability to make them evolve in the midst of chaos.

ARTISTIC DIRECTION

Goblin Dice & Cleave plunges players into a world of wacky science-fantasy, halfway between cyberpunk and fantasy. All sprinkled with a tangy sense of humor.

The game is based on an original narrative universe developed by the studio's creative director. A novel blending cyberpunk and fantasy through a creepy-cute aesthetic.

content_descriptors.notes: Goblin Dice & Cleave is a dark fantasy/cyberpunk Dicebuilder RPG that features frequent violent and gory scenes (including limb amputation, torture, and bodily fluids) alongside mild sexual themes—characters in revealing outfits (succubus) and a bare-chested vampire. Player discretion is advised.
